definitions.explanation: Widely known and recognized, especially for achievements or expertise. A formal word used mainly in writing and formal speech.

examples.japanese: {著名|ちょめい}な⟦{建築家|けんちくか}→建築家：06082_kenchikuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was designed by a renowned architect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{著名|ちょめい}な⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a prominent researcher in that field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{著名|ちょめい}な⟦{指揮者|しきしゃ}→指揮者：06565_shikisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}いて→招く：02425_maneku⟧⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A concert was held with a world-renowned conductor as guest.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written-style word. In everyday conversation, ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧ is far more common. {著名|ちょめい} implies being well known for notable achievements or expertise, while ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧ is broader and can include fame from any cause (including notoriety).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Prenominal: {著名|ちょめい}な + noun ({著名|ちょめい}な⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧)
- Pattern: ～⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{著名|ちょめい}: famous for ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {著名|ちょめい}な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧: notable figure
- {著名|ちょめい}な⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧: renowned scholar
- {著名|ちょめい}な⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: noted writer
- ⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{著名|ちょめい}: world-renowned
- ⟦{著名人|ちょめいじん}→著名人：23055_chomeijin⟧: famous person, celebrity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧: famous — the everyday word; broader and more casual
- {高名|こうめい}: renowned, illustrious — more literary, implies high reputation
